::: {.callout-note collapse=true title="No project values yet? Start with standard cases"}

- **[Battery storage](preset-catalog.qmd#preset-battery_system):** Compare Keine Batterie (no battery) with the two storage options. Check capacity and power.

- **[Flexibility control](preset-catalog.qmd#preset-flexibility_system):** Compare Keine Flexibilität (no flexibility) with control using PV or PV plus an external signal.

- **[Thermal flexibility](preset-catalog.qmd#preset-flexibility_thermal):** Start with a temperature range matching the comfort concept and check permissible room temperatures.

Check the applied values for your project. [How to apply presets](presets.qmd).

:::
